statement: Validation constraints can be a separate layer from the data vocabulary.
actakit_implication: Profiles/locators/outputs should have versioned validators rather than arbitrary JSON.

statement: Typed/versioned validation contracts are a safer extension mechanism than arbitrary payloads.
actakit_implication: Locator/profile/output config schemas must be versioned and validated.

statement: Validation standards continue to evolve with explicit test suites; conformance results are bounded by the shapes/tests executed.
actakit_implication: Treat validation reports as versioned process evidence, never as approval or truth state.
